name: Litho
description: Lithographic crayon: the grain of the stone showing as broken diagonal strokes.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; rect*6 { x: calc(@n(-1) * 17 - 4); y: -20; width: 9; height: 140; transform: rotate(-24 50 50); fill: #000 }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; rect*6 { x: calc(@n(-1) * 17 - 4); y: -20; width: 9; height: 140; transform: rotate(-24 50 50); fill: #000 }); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
